Lot description: Allgemein Grundmaß der Rollcontainer: L/B 1.200 mm x 800 mm. Die Länge kann mit Rücksprache und Notwendigkeit auf bis zu 1.400mm verlängert werden. Material: Aluminiumprofile, Verbinder, Gelenke, Abdeck- kappe, Abdeck- und Einfassprofil, Aluminiumbleche, verleimte Siebdruckplatte. The attitude state must therefore be reconstructed from non-cooperative laser-ranging observables, making use of time-of-flight/range measurements, return-signal characteristics, pass geometry, target geometry, known or estimated surface properties, and attitude-dynamics modelling. Where beneficial, the laser-ranging data maybe complemented by passive optical or radar observations.The activity will assess the feasibility, achievable accuracy and uncertainty of attitude determination and dynamics-based propagation from ground. It will characterise and propagate target dynamics, in particular spin rate and spin-axis orientation, and will provide statistically meaningful uncertainty envelopes for ERASE Phase A design trade-offs. The activity will also prepare the capability to perform repeated attitude characterisation campaigns in support of ERASE. The attitude state of non-cooperative targets may evolve over time due to environmental torques and target-specific dynamics; therefore, measurements may be required not only during the present feasibility phase, but also before launch, to confirm that the target conditions remain within the design assumptions, and potentially at intermediate points during mission preparation. A dedicated task will assess the applicability of the developed measurement and modelling methods to a broader range of large, unprepared, non-cooperative low Earth orbit targets beyond Metop and Sentinel-1, identifying the key target properties, observation conditions and limitations that determine feasibility.
